hypothesis: Public-TRAIN-learned parity-resolution templates can construct valid new constraints on unknown nonlinear causal-law truth-table bits from masked joint transition observations, reducing certified inference work versus equally trained exact Gaussian-elimination and deterministic closure baselines without wrong certified answers.
new_problem: Public feedback supplies output-node parities over 2 and 3 nodes, not individual outputs; observed pair/triple parity equations permit algebraic elimination into learned singleton unknown-rule-bit constraints.

source.observations_per_trial: two XOR parity observations per trial: one over 2 distinct output nodes and one over 3 distinct output nodes, revealing neither individual output (degree-2 and degree-3 constraints permit TRAIN-induced singleton resolution)
source.future_query: known query start, do at first step, 3 synchronous updates, three target nodes
source.DEV_rule_class: genuinely nonaffine, withheld and disjoint from TRAIN affine

learned_mechanism.TRAIN: Count publicly derived GF(2) rowmask-pair resolution signatures that produce new singleton law-bit clauses; select top 32 ordered rowmask pairs without private source labels.
learned_mechanism.inference: Use trained templates to XOR matching observed parity rows and append new logically implied singleton truth-table constraints *before* any exact closure or law enumeration. Use the resulting learned unit clauses to filter law candidates; use exact GF(2) reduction on the remaining original constraints. Unseen patterns use exact fallback.
learned_mechanism.ablation: Disable the learned clause templates on the SAME TRAIN public cases. Require >0 cases with new, nonduplicate singleton clauses AND a changed actual constraint-state construction, with identical complete truth-table posterior sets and counterfactual certifications. Merely sorting graph/law candidates does not qualify.
learned_mechanism.proof: Every inferred clause (a XOR b, u XOR v) must be backed by the two public row equations; independently brute enumerate all graph/mode/law models to confirm the exact posterior, no unsupported clause, never prune true law.
learned_mechanism.limitations: A parity XOR template is an algebraically sound learned inference policy, not proof of new learned physical dynamics; require strict evidence beyond the engineering ablation for scientific positive.

prospective.strict_resource_and_capability_acceptanc: No CPU or RSS regression relative to best fully TRAIN-informed exact control, and strictly lower complete native work or higher correctly certified sound coverage

mechanism_mathematical_reason: XOR of a degree-2 row and degree-3 row can cancel two unknown-law-bit terms to derive a sound degree-1 unit clause; pair-only constraints cannot derive unit clauses from XOR alone.
